liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mission In The Rain** (3 reviews): Listener calls the track a quintessential trip into Jerry's soulful singing; Listener calls the song beautiful and notes the band played it rarely [15][19][20]
- **Slipknot!** (1 review): Listener compares Keith's playing to Europe 72, saying he really leads the jam [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-06-10.matrix.tobin.84985.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 182 min; rated 5/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd1976-06-10.sbd.gems.82921.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 183 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd76-06-10.warburton.minches.18426.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 25 songs; 189 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1976-06-10.145134.akg1000.warburton.smith.sirmick.flac1644**: source not stated; 22 songs; 188 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [9]
- **gd76-06-10.sbd.bertha-ashley.23370.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 177 min; rated 4.31/5 by 32 [10]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the Music Hall sound quality as unbelievable and a real treat; Sound is described as rich, warm, deep, and nicely balanced with brightness [13][22]

## Around the show

- Listener notes Jerry is barely audible in the intro of The Music Never Stopped [23]
- Listener rates the setlist as convincing enough for a download [15]
- Reviewer says the band lacks the sparkle and imagination of the previous night [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-06-10.matrix.tobin.84985.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix(65%-SBD/35%-AUD) [1]. Also: SHNs decoded to wave and reassembled into one long file using Audition 2.0 [1]
- **gd1976-06-10.sbd.gems.82921.flac16**: taped by DAT from the collection of Todd Evans; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: SBD Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat (44.1k) [2]. Also: Static in Sugaree patched with shnid 14264; warble in Cassidy improved in Spectrum [2]
- **gd76-06-10.warburton.minches.18426.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jimmy Warburton; transferred by Mark Cohen, David Minches; source: Audience Recording: AKG 1000Es [4]. Also: Recorded by Jimmy Warburton using AKG 1000Es and Sony TC-152 [4]
- **gd1976-06-10.145134.akg1000.warburton.smith.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Jimmy Warburton; transferred by Matt Smith & Sirmick; source: AKG 1000Es > Sony TC-152 (Dolby b) > MAC - Recorded by Jimmy Warburton from right-hand side of loge. [9]. Also: Eight-second patch in Row Jimmy sourced from shnid 18425; tape flip smoothed [9]
- **gd76-06-10.sbd.bertha-ashley.23370.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Snooky Flowers Grateful Dead: [1976-06-09 Boston Music Hall, Boston, MA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1976-06-09-boston-music-hall-boston-ma-usa/) [26]
